units: <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 63:8">Gen. R. s. 63</cite> <he>על טי׳ דמדינ׳</he> Ar. (ed. <he>מטכסא</he>) on the rampart of the fortress (in spite of the gates being closed); <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 110:24">Yalk. Gen. 110</cite>.—Pl. <he>טִיסְסַיָּיא</he>, <cite ref="I00361"><he>טִכְ׳</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Eichah Rabbah 1">Lam. R. to I, 5</cite> <he>פליג ד׳ ט׳ וכ׳</he> he assigned the demolition of the four ramparts of the Temple mount to the four generals, and the western gate came under the command of Pangar.
